A one-shot iterator is therefore consumed exactly once. The loop and the extend both see the same full list, in yield order. An empty iterable, including an empty generator, returns early before `setdefault`, so it doesn't create the key. Lists, tuples and ranges behave as before, with only a small extra copy.
